proposed_widenings.name: perform_standard_action
proposed_widenings.justification: The current surface can spend a Bonus Action and grant temp HP, but it cannot encode that the activation itself performs a specific standard action. `grant_extra_action` is wrong because Adrenaline Rush does not grant an extra action; it lets the user take the Dash action as the bonus-action activation.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You can take the Dash action as a Bonus Action. When you do so, you gain a number of Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus.

notes: Stopped before authoring content JSON/Dhall. Species-trait activation fits structurally, but the closed atom vocabulary cannot honestly represent the Dash-as-bonus-action mechanic. Encoding only the temp HP rider would omit the trait's primary action-economy effect.
